summary: Public projects created on 24 October 2026: 3 repos, 3 datasets and 2 models.
intro: Agent tooling covers a Kaizen plugin for steady task breakdown and a hook that spots unrelated tasks and moves them to a fresh session. Speech recognition work includes a model that adds paragraph breaks to flat transcripts, an ASR cleanup model, and training data for both.

projects.name: Kaizen Please
projects.description: Kaizen for any project, not just code: small steady steps, task breakdown, reviews, a Kaizen assessment essay, clean uninstall. Agent skills.

projects.name: New Task Split
projects.description: Claude Code hook: a local ONNX classifier detects an unrelated new task and moves it to a fresh session

projects.name: Proofed
projects.description: Proofed: integrated ASR + post-processing model, from speech straight to clean, proofed text.

projects.description: Adds paragraph breaks to flat speech-to-text output. Speech recognition returns punctuated, cased text as one block; this model decides, word by word, where a new paragraph starts.
